name: SaaS Directory

sources.title: Homepage — categorized SaaS/PaaS/IaaS directory with 'Suggest an app', registration, and user reviews
Suggest an app — returned only the site shell when fetched anonymously; likely requires login

conditions: Free suggestion route exists ('Suggest an app') but the page rendered an empty shell to an anonymous visitor — a registered account (register-saas-directory.php) is almost certainly required, and editorial acceptance decides whether the app is listed
requirements: Product must be a SaaS/PaaS/IaaS app — directory is organized into categories like Online CRM, Project Management, eCommerce, Backup and Storage
User accounts exist (Login/Registration in nav); reviewers can leave public comments/ratings on listings
Site also sells sponsored/advertising slots ('Advertise here')
preparation: Product name, URL, and a one-paragraph description
Best-fit category from the taxonomy (Business & Trade, Cloud Computing, Utilities and Services, or App)
workflow: Create an account at https://www.saasdirectory.com/register-saas-directory.php and log in
Open https://www.saasdirectory.com/suggest-an-app.php and submit the app details
Wait for editorial review; accepted apps appear in the chosen category and on the homepage 'Latest applications' list
watchFor: Suggest-an-app page renders empty without a session — register first
Old-school directory (Spanish origin; en/es/eu locales); listing quality and link attributes unverified
Paid advertising exists — do not confuse 'Advertise here' with the free suggestion route
Recent comments look like promotional reviews; avoid soliciting fake reviews
countsAsLive: The product appears as a listing page under its category on saasdirectory.com and shows in 'Latest applications added'
unknowns: Whether the free suggestion route is still actively reviewed (site design is dated)
Exact form fields behind the login wall
Whether listing links are follow or nofollow
